featured_reviews.name: Govind Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
DMart Mulund is undoubtedly one of the best hypermarkets in Mulund and nearby areas, especially when it comes to Everyday Low Prices. From groceries, personal care products, household essentials, kitchenware, and clothing to selected electrical appliances like fans, coolers, induction cooktops, kettles, and hair dryers—everything is available under one roof at very affordable prices. It is an ideal place for bulk and monthly grocery shopping and truly easy on the pocket.
One of the biggest advantages of this DMart is that the entire store is located on a single floor, making it extremely convenient to navigate. The store is spacious, well-organized, and neatly laid out, with clearly marked sections and a wide product range. Cleanliness is well maintained, which adds to a comfortable and pleasant shopping experience.
🚗 Parking is another major plus point. In a city like Mumbai, having ample parking space makes shopping stress-free and convenient, especially for families.
🎉 During festive seasons, especially Diwali, the management deserves special appreciation. Both senior and junior staff handle the festive rush very efficiently. Additional staff is deployed to manage crowds, ensure quick refilling of shelves, and assist customers politely and patiently. This thoughtful approach significantly improves customer convenience during peak times.
💰 When it comes to pricing, DMart Mulund clearly stands out. Most products are priced lower compared to local stores and other supermarkets. The apparel section has also improved over time, offering a decent collection of T-shirts, shirts, and everyday wear at reasonable prices.
⚠️ The only downside is the heavy crowd, especially on weekends and during peak hours. Movement through aisles can be slow, and long queues at billing counters are common despite having more than 20 checkout counters. Additionally, there is some scope for improvement in staff politeness at the customer service desk.
👉 Pro tip: Visit early on weekday mornings for a smoother and less crowded experience. Alternatively, the DMart Ready option is very convenient—order online and collect for free from the pickup point or opt for home delivery at a nominal charge.
📍 One minor inconvenience is that getting a rickshaw after 9 PM can sometimes be difficult, so it’s better to plan transportation accordingly.
✅ Overall Verdict:
DMart Mulund is a true one-stop shopping destination that offers excellent value for money, a wide variety of products, good cleanliness, and convenient facilities. While the crowd requires a bit of patience, the savings and product range make it completely worth it. After visiting multiple DMart stores, this one remains my most preferred choice.
Highly recommended for families, monthly shoppers, and budget-conscious customers

featured_reviews.name: Naveenkumar Tiwari
featured_reviews.review_text:
Dmart in Mulund is the undisputed leader for Everyday Low Prices in the region. This hypermarket consistently delivers deep discounts on groceries, personal care, and apparel that are genuinely hard to beat, making it the top choice for bulk and monthly shopping. The store is spacious, well-stocked with a vast product range, and, importantly for Mumbai, offers ample parking. These strengths firmly establish it as a convenient, budget-friendly, one-stop solution.
​However, the store’s popularity is its main weakness. The Mulund branch suffers from intense overcrowding, especially on weekends and during peak hours. This congestion leads to frustratingly slow aisle navigation and the infamous Dmart drawback: extremely long queues at the billing counters. Shoppers often spend an inordinate amount of time waiting to check out. Furthermore, staff behavior and efficiency at the customer service desk can be inconsistent.
​Ultimately, Dmart Mulund is excellent for maximizing value, but you must strategically manage your visit. For a less stressful experience, shop early on weekday mornings. If saving money is your highest priority, the Mulund store is worth the patience required.

How Modern Retail Redefined the Marketplace

By prioritizing deep discounts and price transparency, these platforms have forced local vendors to abandon arbitrary pricing and improve their customer service to stay relevant. This shift has transitioned the market from "seller-driven" to "buyer-centric," ensuring that today’s consumer receives both better value and well-deserved respect.
